d: Ash-brown hair falls in soft, straight waves with a side parting and long bangs framing a mature, youthful face. The eyes are a pale, hazy lavender with a calm, distant expression. A slender build is dressed in a gothic maid-inspired outfit consisting of a dark navy blue bodice and a voluminous black skirt layered with a white apron featuring celestial circular patterns, complemented by a dark navy bonnet with white lace trim and a large royal blue bow at the neck. Signature details include a silver-toned tray tucked into the apron and a small black handheld device held in the right hand.
